artworks.title: Courtyard with Domed Building in Ruins
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This image shows a desolate landscape with crumbling stone buildings. A path lined with rubble fades into the distance. The sky is expansive above, with more ruined structures on the horizon. A domed structure on the left and a damaged building on the right are prominent features. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving a vintage quality and emphasizing the decay of the architecture.

artworks.title: Church of Sts. Peter and Paul
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural view of an ancient temple-like structure taken from a low perspective. The structure features tall, fluted columns supporting an intricately designed pediment with a relief carving of a bird. In the foreground, there is a horse or mule-drawn cart with visible wooden wheels and harness. Surrounding the building are sparse bushes and a few trees, casting shadows on the temple. The photograph is in a monochrome sepia tone, adding a vintage atmosphere. The temple's weathered stones suggest age and exposure to the elements.

artworks.title: Street in Sebastopol
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a deserted street lined with dilapidated buildings. Tree remains and rubble are scattered along the sidewalk. The sky dominates the scene and there are a few figures in the distance. The overall color palette is sepia-toned, giving the photo an aged look.

artworks.title: Maison Vertu, Sebastopol
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a Gothic-style building from a slightly elevated angle. The building's side and front facades are visible with no prominent horizon in the background. The architecture features pointed arches and spires typical of Gothic design, accentuating verticality. The building is enclosed by an ornate black iron fence, with people standing outside. The scene is in sepia tone, giving it a vintage appearance. The building's walls display a smooth texture with signs of wear, conveying a sense of history. Nearby leafless branches suggest a winter setting. Additional rooftops can be seen in the distance, implying an urban environment.

artworks.title: Post-Mortem Baby on Bed
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (cabinet card)
artworks.description: The image shows an infant lying on a bed dressed in a long white gown. The baby is positioned lying on its back, resting on a large pillow. The infant's features include closed eyes and a small face, with short hair apparent on the head. The gown covers the infant entirely, adorned with embroidery and frills around the neck and sleeves. The bed is covered with a textured blanket, and a lacy curtain with an intricate design hangs in the background. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects in the image.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (cabinet card)
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned oval portrait of a woman. She is wearing a dark dress with puffed sleeves and lace detailing on the collar. Her hair is styled up, and her facial features include a high forehead, defined cheekbones, and slightly turned eyes. A white fabric drapes over her clothing. Above the portrait are illustrations of an owl and a small animal on branches. The background has a textured design, resembling brushstrokes or clouds. The bottom of the image includes the signature and branding of a photographic studio, "Gardner Extra Finish, Napoleon, Ohio." The photo has a scalloped edge border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (cabinet card)
artworks.description: The image shows a cropped portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is positioned with her head turned slightly to the right and eyes gazing in the same direction. Her facial features are soft and defined, with a fair complexion, sharp brows, and a gentle expression. Her hair is styled neatly, possibly pinned up or curled beneath an elaborate hat adorned with a large ribbon and lace. She is dressed in a high-collared outfit with intricate embroidery and a floral brooch pinned at the center of her collar. A cluster of flowers is draped over her chest, complimenting the elegant attire. The background is a plain sepia tone.

artworks.title: Le Masque au caffé (The Masked Man Taking Coffee)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in an elaborate historical outfit. They wear a tricorn hat and a dark cloak with a veil partially covering their face. The person is dressed in 18th-century style clothing, holding a small cup. Nearby, there are cups, bottles, and a jug on a table, as well as a decorative chair with a patterned seat. The background consists of a plain wall with curtains or drapes.

artworks.title: La Cuisiniere (The Cook)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her hands clasped in front of her. She is dressed in a long, layered dress with a lace or frilled collar. Her hair is styled in a bun, and she has a subtle smile on her face. In the background, there is a hearth with a pot above flames and smoke rising, a table with various kitchen items, and plates and bottles arranged on a mantelpiece. The title "la Cuisiniere" is displayed beneath the image.

artworks.title: Le Zendale (Woman in a Hood, or the Woman Returning from Church)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in a public space. She is in a relaxed posture, facing slightly left with her head turned to the right. Her face is partially covered by a veil, revealing only her nose and mouth. The woman wears a long, dark dress, gloves, and holds an object in her right hand. In the background is an architectural structure resembling a church with two spires. A small dog is at her feet, looking up. The scene is outdoors with an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Le Marchand allant à Rialto (The Merchant at the Rialto)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking away from the viewer. The person wears a tricorn hat and a cloak, with only their breeches and shoes visible. Their head is turned slightly to the right. In the background, there is a bridge over water and a row of buildings with many windows, under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Le Gondolier (The Gondolier)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing at a slight angle, facing right with one foot forward. He has a robust build, short curly hair, and is wearing a round hat with a folded top. He wears a striped shirt, voluminous pants, and holds an object resembling a lantern. The background features a river or canal with architectural structures on the opposite bank, and a gondola is visible on the left side.

artworks.title: La Dame Venitienne en abit de masque (Venetian Woman in Carnival Dress)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing outdoors. She is holding a closed fan in front of her. She has an elaborate updo and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat with ribbons and a feather. She is dressed in an ornate gown and a dark cape. The background features classical buildings and columns under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Gaspar Gribolari brocanteur à Padoue (Gaspar Gribolari, Secondhand Dealer in Padua)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing outdoors. He is standing upright, holding papers in his left hand while his right hand is hidden under his coat. His face is wide with pronounced cheeks and thinning, curly hair. He is wearing a long coat, knee-high socks, and buckle shoes. In the background, there is a tall stone fountain with a lion's head spout, and a building with a smoking chimney. Plants and flowers are scattered on the ground. The illustration style is shaded and etched, focusing on the man and his surroundings.

artworks.title: Le Perruquier fatigué (The Tired Wigmaker)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a chair, slumped to their side with their eyes closed and head leaning down. They are wearing a robe, stockings, and shoes, with one leg crossed over the other. Around them is a table with various items, and on the floor are a hat, scissors, and a comb. The background is a simple interior setting with a tiled floor.

artworks.title: Femme de Palestrina (Woman from Pellestrina)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing on the shore with her back facing the viewer. She is wearing a shawl and holding a fishing pole with a fish in her hand. A male figure is next to her tending to a fishing net in the water. In the background, there is a sea with a boat on the horizon, and fish are seen on the shore.

artworks.title: Habits des nobles (Dress of the Noblemen)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing close to each other. Both men have long, curly hair, prominent noses, and chins. They wear elaborate noble attire with long overcoats, wide cuffs, intricate patterns, and fur trimmings. The man on the left gestures with his hand, displaying lace trim at the cuff, while the man on the right holds folded papers. In the background, an architectural structure with tall arches and sculptures within the recesses is visible. The sky above is softly rendered with clouds.

artworks.title: La Servante (The Servant)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with a round tray in her left hand at waist level. She has an oval face, downturned eyes, a straight nose, and a closed mouth. Her hair is covered with a headscarf. She wears a long dress with a fitted bodice, a laced front, a full skirt, and an apron. The sleeves are long and the neckline is modest. She wears simple shoes and there are potted plants on either side of her. In the background, there is a structure and steps leading downwards, with sky visible above.

artworks.title: Le Paveur (The Road Paver)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing in a three-quarter view. He has a prominent nose and chin, short hair, and wears a dark coat, knee-length trousers, and a worn light-colored apron. In his hands, he holds a hat and either shoes or tools. Nearby are a wooden bucket and a masonry trowel. In the background is an aged stone wall with visible mortar and patches.

artworks.title: Chiesa dedicata à S. Pietro Apostolo (Church of San Pietro in Montorio)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Pat Clopper in memory of Jeffrey Clopper
artworks.description: The scene depicts a church building dominating the right side. The horizon is low, with an expansive sky above. The church has an ornate facade with a round window and bell tower, accompanied by a staircase. To the left, there is a fountain with sculptures and trees. The etching style features detailed linework with cross-hatching for texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with variations in line density for light and shadow. Figures are present near the fountain and church steps.

artworks.title: Don Chepito
artworks.medium: relief etching on pink paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: This is a print showing a bull tossing a person in the air. The bull faces the left, its front legs raised, its head lowered, and its tail swishing in the air. There appears to be an object sticking out of the bull's back, next to a small flower. The person is on the left, lifted into the air by the horns of the bull. Their back is towards the ground, with their limbs raised up. The person is depicted with exaggerated features, including a round bald head, wide eyes, and an open mouth. They are wearing a light-colored shirt and trousers with black shoes. Below them on the ground is an umbrella and a hat. The drawing is on a plain brown background.

artworks.title: The Dream of the Doctor
artworks.artist: Wenzel von Olmutz, after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, laid down on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring three figures. One figure is a standing nude with long hair and a draped cloth, another is a seated figure appearing meditative, and a small winged figure at the bottom is using a compass on a spherical object. The setting includes architectural elements and detailed background textures, along with mythological or allegorical storytelling elements in the composition.

artworks.title: The Yosemite Valley from the Mariposa Trail
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Earl A. Powell, III
artworks.description: The image shows a valley from an elevated viewpoint. In the background, distant mountains fade into the sky. A rugged cliff is on the left, and a rock formation with a waterfall is on the right. Pine trees cover the foreground, contrasting with the mountains. The image is in black and white, highlighting the textures and forms of the landscape.

artworks.title: Samson and Delilah
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in a dramatic scene. The artwork features intricate line work, emphasizing texture and depth. The scene takes place in an architectural setting with grand columns and classic drapery. The figures are shown with dynamic poses, one lying on the ground, while others interact expressively. Elements like spears and helmets add a martial aspect. The composition guides the viewer's eye through various points of interest.
